title: Profit, Loss, Discount and GST
summary: Cost price, selling price, marked price and discounts, and how GST is added.

ib.note: Financial maths in context is MYP 3 Criterion D

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 1: Fractions in Disguise

objectives: I can calculate profit and loss, and profit or loss percentage.
I can calculate discounts on marked prices.
I can add GST to a price.
misconceptions: Profit % is calculated on the selling price.
A discount is taken from the cost price.
GST is part of the shop's profit.
